name: Abstract strategy games
short_definition: An AI system that plays perfect-information board games such as chess and Go: searching over discrete states, planning many moves ahead under fixed rules, and evaluating positions. The measured object is the trained agent together with its search procedure.

name: Real-time video games
short_definition: An AI system that plays video games in real time from perceptual input: tracking a dynamic environment, acting under time pressure, and coordinating several concurrent objectives. The measured object is the trained agent acting in the game environment.

name: Image recognition
short_definition: An AI system that assigns labels to the objects present in a still image, detecting and categorising visual content at fine grain and under variation in pose, lighting and occlusion. The measured object is the trained vision model.

name: Visual question answering
short_definition: An AI system that answers natural-language questions about the content of an image, combining visual perception with language understanding and requiring inference that neither modality supplies alone. The measured object is the trained multimodal model.

name: Generating images
short_definition: An AI system that synthesises a novel image from a description or a reference, composing scene, style and detail so that the result is both faithful to the prompt and visually coherent. The measured object is the trained generative model.

name: Reading comprehension
short_definition: An AI system that answers questions about a supplied passage of text by locating and combining the relevant evidence within it, rather than by recalling facts learned in training. The measured object is the trained model reading the supplied passage.

name: Language modeling
short_definition: An AI system that predicts and produces fluent text, following instructions and sustaining coherence across a passage. The measured object is the trained language model itself, acting without external tools.

name: Translation
short_definition: An AI system that renders text from one natural language into another, preserving meaning, register and idiom. The measured object is the trained translation model.

name: Speech recognition
short_definition: An AI system that transcribes recorded speech into text under accent, background noise and conversational overlap. The measured object is the trained acoustic and language model pipeline.

name: Agentic task execution
short_definition: An AI system that plans and carries out multi-step tasks autonomously in a digital environment: browsing, using tools and APIs, operating software, writing and running code, and recovering from its own errors over a long horizon. The measured object is the model together with its scaffolding, since that is what a firm deploys.

name: Mathematical and scientific reasoning
short_definition: An AI system that solves problems requiring multi-step formal reasoning: competition and research mathematics, proof construction, and graduate-level scientific questions where the answer cannot be retrieved and must be derived.

name: Software engineering
short_definition: An AI system that resolves real software-engineering tasks in an existing codebase: reading an issue, locating the relevant code, writing a patch that passes the project's own tests, and doing so without human intervention.
